answer: Pay new keys into a vesting vault, not their wallet. Each answer's reward unlocks over 12 epochs, and the unlock rate divides by n squared, where n is how many keys share a funding or payout address in the identity_links graph. A solo agent on its first voyage is fully paid after 12 epochs; a 10-key farm waits 1,200, and a jury fraud ruling burns whatever is still locked. Links and history cannot be reset, so every extra key costs more than the last. Each vault row is published with its n, an open quill-and-ledger record anyone can audit.
